note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English, with soldier, worker and alate described. Distribution records, synonymic citations and figure numbers are not included.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate antennae 15-segmented, compound eyes large and protruding, slightly longer than wide, ocelli separated from the compound eye by about half the minor ocellar diameter; soldier head capsule pyriform, antennae 13-segmented, mandibles vestigial; worker head capsule subquadrate and rounded, antennae 14-segmented.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale reddish brown or orange with a brownish tinge, rostrum slightly darker than the head capsule; antennae light brown; pronotum pale yellowish brown, the rest of the body paler. Posterior part of the head with 2 setae and a few microsetae; apex of the rostrum with a few setae; anterior part of the pronotum with microsetae; abdominal tergites with microsetae, those of the last segments slightly longer; sternites with long and short setae. Body length 3.20–3.65 mm. Head capsule pyriform, slightly constricted behind the antennae; length with rostrum 1.17–1.52 mm, length without rostrum 0.78–1.08 mm, maximum width 0.67–0.88 mm; in lateral view almost straight, with only a shallow elevation. Rostrum cylindrical, slightly longer than half the length of the head without rostrum, 0.53–0.60 mm long. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Mandibles vestigial, each with a short spine-like process. Pronotum saddle-shaped, 0.13–0.25 mm long, 0.39–0.51 mm wide.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule dark yellowish brown, postclypeus paler than the head capsule, antennae pale yellow; legs and thorax pale yellowish brown; abdomen greyish white. Head and body rather densely pilose. Body length 3.80–4.50 mm. Head capsule subquadrate and rounded, length of head to the base of the mandibles 0.85 mm, maximum width 1.00–1.03 mm; coronal suture distinct; fontanelle plate oval and protruding. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 subequal to segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus slightly convex and pilose, less than half as long as wide, 0.16–0.17 mm long, 0.45 mm wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin without a notch, 0.20 mm long, 0.50–0.55 mm wide.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule reddish brown to brown, postclypeus paler than the head capsule and brownish yellow, antennae yellowish brown, abdominal tergites pale brown. Head rather densely pilose, with many short setae and a few scattered long setae; pronotal pilosity similar to that of the head. Head capsule subcircular, length of head to the base of the mandibles 0.83–0.96 mm, width including the compound eyes 1.06–1.19 mm. Fontanelle plate prominent and large, broadly oval, anterior margin concave, anterolateral angles acute. Compound eyes large and protruding, subcircular, slightly longer than wide, maximum diameter 0.33–0.39 mm, minimum diameter 0.31–0.33 mm. Ocelli broadly oval, separated from the compound eye by about half their minor diameter, major diameter 0.15–0.18 mm, minor diameter 0.09–0.10 mm, ocellus–eye distance 0.03–0.06 mm. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 as long as segment 2, segment 4 shorter than or subequal to segment 3. Postclypeus slightly convex and pilose, less than half as long as wide, 0.13–0.16 mm long, 0.36–0.41 mm wide. Pronotum nearly trapezoidal, 0.52–0.57 mm long, 0.85–1.05 mm wide, anterior margin straight and without a notch, posterior margin convex and incurved.
